notes:
Should go Page -> Squire -> Knight

The Apprentice side learns the powers of the void. Void Knight is reachable from both sides: through Squire the void took him (no spells), through Apprentice he took the void (keeps what the Apprentice taught him).

This guy has low base stats but high growth rates - with investment, we intend for him to be the most fearsome player unit in the game

Tier 2 gets the option to *dabble* in the magical arts: the Apprentice.
